purpose: Add a relevant side note to the current topic.
keywords: The venue is beside the station. Incidentally, there is no parking.
My sister wrote this book. She also painted the cover, incidentally.
The fee is one thousand yen. Students pay half, by the way.
restrictions: The addition should connect to the preceding topic.
mistake: Use a topic-changing expression for an unrelated subject.
